claim: New § 15.501 extends the buyout cap, one-year duration limit, and five-mile geographic limit to dentists, nurses, and physician assistants.
evidence: Under the newly created Section 15.501, the statute now expressly applies to certain non-physician healthcare practitioners, including: Dentists (licensed by the Texas Board of Dental Examiners); Registered and vocational nurses (licensed under Chapter 301, Occupations Code); Physician assistants (licensed under Chapter 204).
